channel.title: RVA Burlesque

item.title: Under The Veil: A Night Of Burlesque & Variety Entertainment
item.description:
When: Tuesday, July 7, 2026 · 9pm

Where: The Veil Brewing - Scott's Addition, 1509B Belleville St, Richmond, VA 23230

item.title: RVA Burlesque Festival 2026
item.description:
When: Thursday, November 5, 2026

Where: Richmond, VA

Annual multi-day burlesque festival celebrating the art of burlesque in Richmond, VA through artistic expression, diversity, and empowerment. The 2026 event runs November 5th–7th; specific venue, schedule, and ticket details not yet announced.
